scope: Full-source publication consistency. No claim of LMX execution, parser/type checking, XLSX formula evaluation or PDF visual QA.

method.nonwhitespace_characters: Unicode code points with str.isspace()==False; every declaration, Throws entry, comment and literal is counted
method.utf8_bytes: Complete canonical UTF-8 source including whitespace and final LF
method.csv: UTF-8 BOM; exact identities, full-source character/line values and optional byte counts
method.styles: Four client contracts publish both procedural and functional source metrics; common implementations remain one body. Legacy listing.LMX is a compatibility mirror, never a third compared listing.
method.alternatives: Explicit explanatory sources are checked against their metadata and do not replace either compared style.
